💰 The most common use case is metered knowledge work.
1️⃣ A firm sends a document, a ticket, or a code repo to a model. The model returns a draft. The firm pays per token or per seat. That loop is metered knowledge work.
2️⃣ Coding is the sharpest form of that loop. Cognition AI sells an agent. The agent writes code and runs code. Anthropic sells the model under that agent. OpenAI sells the same type of model.
3️⃣ Databricks sells the data that the model reads.
4️⃣ Crusoe, Fluidstack, Nscale, Etched, and Fireworks AI sell the power and the chip that run the call.
5️⃣ Harvey sells the loop in law.
6️⃣ ElevenLabs sells it in voice.
7️⃣ Perplexity sells it in search.

7512134757024088064.text:
Deal Teardown

Etched's $300M Series C at a $10.3B valuation, led by Sequoia, doubled the $5B price Stripes set earlier this year. That step-up is anchored to $1B in booked contract orders, yet the company's most recent disclosure put its first inference chip in customer testing with no named buyers and no recognized revenue. The market is effectively underwriting a pre-shipment hardware company based entirely on purchase order volume and founder signal rather than validated silicon performance.
